scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && vite build && node -e "const fs=require('fs'),p=require('path');const src=p.join(__dirname,'dist'),dst=p.join(__dirname,'..','dist');if(!fs.existsSync(src)){console.error('web/dist not found');process.exit(1)}fs.rmSync(dst,{recursive:true,force:true});fs.cpSync(src,dst,{recursive:true});console.log('Copied web/dist -> root dist/')"
